visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair wearing a gray and black plaid shirt sits in an indoor room, holding a black bear plushie with a white 'C' on its chest. The background features a bright yellow shelving unit filled with various books and figurines. The lighting is bright and even, typical of indoor studio settings. Small circular portraits of two other men appear in the bottom corners, framed by traditional Chinese cloud patterns. (2) The scene cuts to a vertical shot of the Taipei 101 skyscraper reaching into a clear, light blue sky. The camera is positioned at a low angle looking up from the street level, emphasizing the immense height and iconic tiered architectural detail of the green-tinted building. The lighting is natural daylight, and the surrounding urban environment is visible at the very base of the tower. (3) The video returns to the man in the plaid shirt, who is actively gesturing with his open hands while speaking. His facial expressions are animated and engage the viewer directly. He remains seated in front of the yellow shelf, and the black bear plush is held stationary in his lap. Yellow and white captions appear at the bottom center of the screen to transcribe his speech. (4) A bustling city street at night is shown, likely a major urban intersection with a dense crowd of pedestrians crossing the road. Numerous glowing neon signs and advertisements in Japanese and Chinese script illuminate the area with vibrant, high-contrast colors. The camera captures a wide-angle view of this fast-paced metropolitan environment under artificial night lighting. (5) Back to the man in the plaid shirt as he continues his historical explanation. He uses his hands frequently to emphasize key points, pointing or sweeping them across the frame. The black bear plush remains a central object in his lap. The static circular portraits of the other two men remain fixed in the lower corners as graphic overlays. (6) A close-up shot shows a person's hands holding a large magnifying glass over a physical world map. The map is marked with several colorful pushpins in blue, yellow, and white, indicating specific geographic locations. The focus is sharp on the magnifying glass lens, which clearly enlarges the map's terrain and printed text beneath it, creating a thematic visual for research. (7) The final shot returns to the man in the plaid shirt, who smiles broadly and makes a welcoming 'come here' gesture with his hands towards the lens. The '大抓同學院' logo is positioned at the very top of the frame. Call-to-action text encouraging comments is overlaid on the screen as the video concludes.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 大抓同學院 KID CAT. [Variety]: 東亞史探索課. [Subtitle]: 臺灣到底是. (2) [Variety]: 東北亞 東南亞. [Subtitle]: 東北亞還是東南亞. (3) [Subtitle]: 多數臺灣人都覺得自己是東北亞的一份子. (4) [Subtitle]: 但如果你把這個問題去問真正的東北亞國家. (5) [Subtitle]: 日本人韓國人多數人都會告訴你. (6) [Subtitle]: 臺灣是東南亞. (7) [Subtitle]: 臺灣算是亞熱帶氣候. (8) [Subtitle]: 我們可以說我們是最北的東南亞. (9) [Subtitle]: 但我們肯定是東南亞的一部分. (10) [Subtitle]: 但是多數人會認為自己是東北亞也不能說錯. (11) [Subtitle]: 因為在歷史上面其實我們文化的確比較接近東北亞. (12) [Subtitle]: 畢竟臺灣是以漢人為主體. (13) [Subtitle]: 被中國 & 日本統治過. (14) [Subtitle]: 在文化認同上的確跟東北亞比較接近. (15) [Subtitle]: 這也說明臺灣其實是一個很獨特的地方. (16) [Variety]: 東北亞 東南亞. [Subtitle]: 夾在東北亞跟東南亞海洋文化交融的所在地. (17) [Subtitle]: 試著用東亞區域的格局來看歷史. (18) [Subtitle]: 可以幫助我們更好的理解臺灣. (19) [Subtitle]: 想知道怎麼讓孩子學好東亞史嗎. (20) [Variety]: 東亞史. [Slogan]: 留言「東亞史」就告訴你更多相關訊息哦.
